title: Deep learning for rice and maize leaf disease recognition: systematic review data and leakage experiments
description: Search records, screening decisions, full-text assessment, coding of 202 included studies, evidence tables, near-duplicate measurements of six public datasets, controlled leakage experiments, the supplementary material and PRISMA 2020 checklist of the paper, and the list of checks run against every reported number (number_checks.txt). Data only: the analysis code is available from the authors on request. Review protocol: OSF Registries 10.17605/OSF.IO/FWZ4S.

notes: Data CC BY 4.0. The analysis code is not published and is available from the authors on request. Full texts of the reviewed articles are not redistributed. Version 1.3.4: supplement revised after peer review (S3 lists the differences between the OSF registration and the review as conducted and maps the registered exclusion codes E1-E6 to the actual steps; new S7 specifies the controlled experiment); number_checks.txt has 68 checks, all passing; README and protocol wording aligned with the paper (equal samples per epoch; role of the AI tool).
